recoveredOwnerLocks.fact: The Dealer is one unique immortal balance-keeper: 195 cm, silver shoulder-length hair, glowing gold eyes, black top hat and tailcoat with gold, ivory vest, burgundy tie, white gloves, ebony staff with Ace of Spades crystal.
The Dealer is neutral: neither hero nor villain; guards balance and free will; cannot force Guardians, personally use Decks, alter history for pity, or favor Guardians or The House.
The Dealer does not directly train Adrian Vale; appears only at crucial balance-threatening moments; Adrian views The Dealer as neither ally nor enemy but as guardian of the rules.
Current hero name is Blackjack. Royal Gambler is no longer the hero name.
Royal Gambler is retained only as an honorific title; civilian identity is Adrian Lucien Vale; role Guardian of Choice.
Chapter 1 title The Man with the Black Deck was accepted by the owner.

Blackjack direction is Epic Fantasy + Steampunk Gothic and distinct from the separate Royal Gambler project; Blackjack remains a Guardian with Top Hat, Black Deck, Royal Cane and elegant strategist identity.
